passages.text: The examples expose three recurring forks. First, an indefinite causal two-point object must either become positive after physical reduction or yield an exact positivity obstruction; neither outcome follows from Hadamard form alone. Second, a portfolio of individually supported ingredients must acquire typed interface theorems before it becomes an end-to-end theory. Third, a bounded empirical success or failure must survive systematics, held-out cases, and physically constrained priors before it bears on a research programme as a whole.
